## Acceptance criteria
1. ADR-006/007 accepted; every bundled proprietary SDK has an audit card in-repo.
2. On the emulator: photo of test meals → items with confidence → corrected → saved into
   the M3 diary with derived provenance; `held` appears when confidence is low.
3. Zoo: model downloads once, hash-verified, shows size before download, reclaim works;
   airplane-mode (emulator network off) after download keeps everything working.
4. Barcode scan → OFF hit → product logged, cached offline, audit row written; no-OFF
text: **M4 implementation complete — 2026-09-12.** Acceptance criteria: (1) **ADR-006** (ONNX Runtime Mobile 1.29.0 now; LiteRT end-state behind migration triggers) + **ADR-007** (MobileNetV2 Food-101, sha256-pinned upstream, Apache-2.0, Food-101 provenance) accepted after verified spike research; audit cards in-repo for ML Kit Barcode, ML Kit Text, ONNX Runtime (docs/tech/audit/) — **ML Kit telemetry opt-out verified nonexistent** (googlesamples/mlkit#593 open) and recorded in the cards. (2) On the API 29 emulator: photo → ONNX analysis → top-5 chips w/ confidence + ai-estimated provenance → swap/edit/remove → saved into the M3 diary (`enteredVia=photo`, provenance `ai-estimate`/`food-classifier/1`); `held` strip at <0.35 top-1 confidence (threshold FLAGGED). (3) Zoo: model downloaded ONCE from huggingface.co (9,835,830 B, sha256-verified, size disclosed pre-download), reclaim works, airplane-mode after download keeps analysis working (`adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable`). (4) Barcode → real OFF hit (EAN-13 → Nutella) → logged; second lookup = CACHE_HIT receipt 0 B; offline/no-OFF degrades to manual search + typed barcode. (5) Debug egress monitor reads the hash-chained receipt ledger: exactly zoo-download ×1 + off-lookup ×2 (ok + cache-hit) after the E2E suite — screenshot-reviewed; "receipts are append-only and hash-chained — editing history is detectable". Tests: 238 JVM + 34 instrumented green; D1–D7+D9 clean (D9 now allowlists ktor/okhttp in :core:network only; D4 asserts INTERNET in :app and nowhere else). Flags for owner: OFF User-Agent contact placeholder `contact@wlo.app`; hold threshold 0.35; correction cache as DataStore document (schema v6 may formalize); `wlo://ai/models` + `wlo://log/capture` registry additions.
